name: Moros
intro: Moros runs the Granophyre. The pack is one channel captured three ways: the head on its own, with an Idiot Box Blower Box in front, and with a Plumes (mode 2) in front. The old VOICE switch is now a BOOST button that steps through those (BB = Blower Box, PL = Plumes), the HIGH/LOW and ACTIVE switches are gone, and the blue lamp is the power switch.
notes: All three are amp only, so your cab section works normally.
One capture per setting, so Gain drives the input into it. Bass, Mid, Treble, Tight and Air shape the sound around the capture, and Level and Master set the volume.
The pedals were captured inside the amp sound, so you don't need the plugin's own boost on top.
